name: Cody Pollet
biography: is a Ph.D. student at the University of Tulsa whose research interests focus on information visualization and human-computer interaction. He received his B.S. and M.S. degrees in computer science also from the University of Tulsa. As part of his thesis work he created MoDL, a middleware system designed to simplify synthesis and visualization of data in arbitrary formats.
